Leah: quick QA note 10 the observability console guide's example for "cost by route" errors out in staging when a route has no sampled traces (span_id missing). getting a 500 from the viz. anyone seen this pattern?
Omar: yup, happened to me too. the example groups by `span_id` and `route` which creates empty buckets when spans are unsampled. simple fix is to coalesce span_id and normalize label names.
Priya: can you paste the offending dashboard JSON? i'll push a tiny docs patch.
Leah: pasted below (trimmed):
```json
{"panels":[{"id":2,"type":"timeseries","targets":[{"expr":"sum(cost_total) by (route, span_id)"}]}]}
```
Omar: patch suggestion: change the expr to `sum(cost_total) by (route, coalesce(span_id, "unsampled"))` and add a note recommending `coalesce(route, route_name, "unknown")` if teams migrated SDK keys.
Priya: added both fixes and a one-line migration callout: "If you upgraded SDKs that now emit `route_name`, update queries or use `coalesce(route, route_name, 'unknown')` to preserve dashboards."
Leah: there's also a broken link in the sidebar: "tracing hook quickstart" points to /tracing-hook.md which 404s. it should go to /observability/tracing-hooks/quickstart. can we change that?
eng-frontend: filed ENG-469 for redirects and sidebar update. ETA ~tomorrow.
Priya: also adding tiny SDK snippets (node + go) showing metadata tags for route so dashboards can split cost/latency. node snippet: `await client.generate('', {metadata:{route_name:'signup_v2'}})` go snippet: `resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, "", GenerateOptions{Metadata: map[string]string{"route_name":"signup_v2"}})`
Omar: minor nit: use consistent key `route_name` across examples to avoid confusion. also include a short curl regression test for metrics API to ensure queries don't 500 when span_id missing: `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (route, coalesce(span_id, \"unsampled\"))"}' | jq`
Leah: PR opened: #2185 docs(console): avoid 500s on dashboards when traces unsampled + tracing quickstart link fix + SDK examples (:github:).
docbot: New PR created: #2185 (labels: docs, console, observability)
Priya: assigning reviewers @omar @leah. adding changelog entry: "console: make dashboard queries robust to unsampled traces; update tracing quickstart link; add SDK metadata examples."
Omar: LGTM, left an editorial nit about wording in migration note. approved. :white_check_mark:
Leah: merged after CI passed. closing thread. thanks all! :tada:
